summary: In VS Code, open the Ansible extension settings, enable Ansible Lightspeed with watsonx inline suggestions, set the URL to https://<node>:8447 and optionally a Model ID Override.
questions: How do I configure the Ansible VS Code extension for Lightspeed?
What URL do I enter for Ansible Lightspeed on containerized AAP?
How do I use a custom watsonx model in VS Code?

answer_card.title: Configure the VS Code extension
answer_card.answer_md:
1. VS Code > **Extensions** > **Ansible** > **Extension Settings** > *Ansible Lightspeed*.
2. Tick *Enable Ansible Lightspeed with watsonx Code Assistant inline suggestions*.
3. *URL for Ansible Lightspeed*: `https://<node>:8447`.
4. Optional: *Model ID Override* for a custom model.
